item.title: Overview of Obadiah - Pride, Judgment, and Deliverance 🟢 NEW
item.description: Adapted from insights by Ray C. Stedman and other biblical reflections. Opening Story # She had never read Obadiah. Perhaps you haven’t either. It is easy to miss, a single page tucked quietly between Amos and Jonah, a book so small you could flip past it without noticing. Most readers never wander into this corner of Scripture. It feels obscure, distant, and, if we’re honest, irrelevant.
